dedupe_keys.name: code of inclusion of flood diversion canal operation in the h08 hydrological model with a case study from the chao phraya river basin model development and validation

description: Saritha Padiyedath Gopalan and Naota Hanasaki publish an H08 hydrological-model extension for flood-diversion canal operation in Thailand’s Chao Phraya basin. Zenodo lists a public code ZIP under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. The describing HESS article says the regional scheme represents diversion through a complex river network and was compared with observed diversion patterns; it also presents a simplified scheme for broader applications. The code can support river-flow and flood-day sensitivity simulations that include canal operations. A related first-review draft covers the describing paper as a case study; this Zenodo code is a separate reusable model resource. A limitation is that Zenodo does not state the archive’s source language, input-file structure or run environment, and regional canal rules may not transfer unchanged to another basin. The article’s reported reduction is a source claim. No code archive was downloaded or model run repeated.
